headline: America says goodbye to JFK
post_facts: An eternal flame marks his grave

scenes.text: [softly] On this day, in nineteen sixty-three... America said goodbye to President John F. Kennedy.

scenes.label: Washington, D.C.
scenes.caption: The procession leaves the White House
scenes.text: [solemnly] A horse-drawn caisson carried his casket to Arlington.

scenes.label: nations sent leaders to mourn
scenes.text: [gravely] Leaders from ninety-two nations came to mourn.

scenes.label: St. Matthew's Cathedral
scenes.caption: Jacqueline Kennedy after the Mass
scenes.text: [softly] Outside the cathedral, his son John, who turned three that day... saluted his father's casket.

scenes.title: A flame that still burns
scenes.text: [gently] At Arlington, Jacqueline Kennedy lit an eternal flame... it still burns today.
